Review Causal?

Causal is praised for its ability to simplify financial modeling with direct data connections and interactive dashboards. Users appreciate its ease of use, especially compared to traditional tools like Excel, and its capacity to create probabilistic forecasts. While some note it still has room to grow to reach enterprise-level functionality, many find it invaluable for understanding and projecting business finances. The tool is recommended for business owners and startup founders seeking to streamline financial processes and save time.
